name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow - Smart Student OD & Leave Management System with Attendance Integration

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
